mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, COALESCE(COUNT(r.review_id), 0) AS review_count, o.description, 0 AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.category = 'OFFICE' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.address, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.phone_number, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, o.description
SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.name FROM merchant_tags mt INNER JOIN tags t ON t.id = mt.tag_id WHERE mt.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY t.name
